_help: Fixes for managing agent names in BCA's data. Names are compared after removing Pte/Ltd, (S)/(Singapore), punctuation and case, and expanding MGT/MGMT to MANAGEMENT. 'merge' maps one firm to another (renames, typos). 'display' sets the name shown on the site. 'notFirm' lists values that aren't a managing agent; names with no business word in them (people's names, 'MCST') are left out automatically. Run npm run build-data to see possible duplicates.

merge.ASCENT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SERVICESPTE L: ASCENT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SERVICES PTE LTD
merge.BARRINGHAM INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY MANAEG: BARRINGHAM INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT PTE LTD
merge.COLLIERS INTERNATIONAL CONSULTANTS & VAL: COLLIERS INTERNATIONAL CONSULTANCY & VALUATION (S) PTE LTD
merge.PHILIP MOHTA MANAGEMENT PTE LTD: PHILIP MOTHA PROPERTY MANAGEMENT PTE LTD
